Masa kerja 4 (empat) tahun sampai dengan kurang dari 5 (lima) tahun + 20% dari upah.
Masa kerja 5 (lima) tahun ke atas + 30% dari upah.
Pekerja yang masa kerjanya belum mencapai 1 (satu) tahun tetapi lebih dari 1 (satu) bulan maka Perusahaan memberikan THR Keagamaan secara proporsional
Komponen upah sebagai dasar perhitungan THR adalah:
Pekerja yang putus hubungan kerjanya terhitung sejak waktu 30 (tiga puluh) hari sebelum jatuh tempo Hari Raya Idul Fitri, berhak atas THR.

Tanggal berakhirnya perjanjian: → 2026-03-28

delta.note: Only the THR formula (Pasal 53) changes a computed fact. The wage base is base salary plus fixed allowances, the THR is pro rata (months/12) below 12 months, and 'more than one month' is read as at least one month in line with the statutory minimum. The rule starts in March 2024, when the agreement took effect. valid_until is left open because the agreement's end (2026-03-28) is given only as metadata and is not stated as a covered month in the text; it should be closed when a new PKB is recorded.

output.reason: This collective labour agreement (PKB) sets company payroll rules for Taekwang workers, including permanent workers, that feed into gross income for PPh 21. It defines the wage components: base salary, fixed allowances, attendance, transport and shift allowances, overtime, Ramadan meal money and incentives. It sets the overtime basis (1/173 of wages, with multipliers). It sets THR at one month's wages plus seniority add-ons of 10%, 20% or 30%. It sets the long-sickness pay percentages. It provides meals in kind (natura), replaced by cash during Ramadan. It requires payroll deductions for PPh and for BPJS contributions.
